A sorry card for when words in a chat are not enough

Saying sorry is hard, and a one-line text can feel cold. This apology card walks in slowly with a sad teddy holding flowers, then shows your letter, written out one line at a time, with the question “Forgive me?” at the end. If they take their time, the teddy sits and waits. When they say yes, there is a hug.

Make a sorry card · ₹30

Preview it free. You only pay when you love it. Now ₹30, usually ₹35.

What’s in your sorry card

  • A sad teddy that walks in with flowers
  • A sealed envelope and a gentle, handwritten-style letter
  • Photos that remind them of better days
  • The question “Forgive me?”, or write your own
  • Soft rain and a calm tune
  • A hug and a quiet celebration when they say yes

Message ideas you can borrow

I messed up, and I know it. You did not deserve that, and I am truly sorry. I would really love the chance to make it right.
I have been thinking about what happened, and I owe you an apology. You matter way more to me than being right.
I am sorry. Not just for what I did, but for how it made you feel. Can we start again?

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹30 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

Will this make them forgive me?

Only you can do that with sincere words. The card gives your words a thoughtful, caring shape.

Can I change the question?

“Forgive me?” is filled in, and you can change it to up to 100 characters.

Is the card private?

Yes. Only people with the link can open it, and search engines are asked not to list it.
